original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT recovers from one authorized physical AC drop with no new errors, hang, blue screen or missing device.
original_method: Map the target AC feed and complete device inventory, preserve baseline, have a qualified operator perform one approved AC off/on action with defined dwell, then verify boot, management, logs, sensors and inventory against baseline.
manual_activity: A qualified operator controls the exact target AC source for one authorized drop and recovery; no CRPS module is removed under this record.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, PSU/AC feed and outlet/control topology
Owner confirmation that operation is AC drop
Authorized operator, dwell and boot timeout
Storage quiescence, abort and final-state rules
safety_requirements: Do not infer or perform CRPS removal
Do not substitute soft power command
Stop on electrical, boot or device anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Collect boot, BMC/OS, sensor and device evidence
Do not control physical power, retry or issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable in method: CRPS module removal belongs to row 799 and is not an AC drop, although both require a human.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Qualified operator performs one topology-verified physical AC drop; automation collects pre/post evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One AC drop, full device population, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen/no-device-loss criteria, script and 30/30-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one feed-verified operator AC drop with preserved baseline and full recovery/inventory comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Clarifies physical operation, dwell, evidence and recovery while prohibiting CRPS substitution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Module removal tests redundancy/status, not whole-SUT AC-loss recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt power loss may corrupt data or reveal boot/device faults.

project_override_considerations: A verified remote PDU action may implement the AC drop under equivalent facility authorization and outlet identity; it does not make the physical-power risk fully automatable.
expected_evidence: Owner resolution, approval and exact AC/PSU topology
Operator/PDU action record and dwell timestamps
Post-drop logs, sensors and full inventory comparison
Final state, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1521 itself consistently defines one AC drop. The CRPS operation exists only in copied DeepSeek data and the separate reused-code variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Owner can resolve the action and supply topology/operator/recovery inputs; until then execution waits but review is not irreducibly blocked.

review_improvement: Preserves the manual boundary while correcting the physical operation from CRPS service to one full-SUT AC drop with recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Manual classification alone is insufficient when the proposed physical action is wrong. Removing a redundant module exercises a different power topology than dropping the SUT AC source, so the exact action must be resolved and bound before any operator proceeds.
